newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli ultra-nationalists fete assassin birthday.
newsitem.headline: Israeli ultra-nationalists fete assassin birthday.

text.p: A handful of Israeli ultra-nationalists will hold a birthday party on Thursday for the religious Jew who murdered Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin, one of them said.
"We're going to have a party with a birthday cake," a Jerusalem resident identified as Haim Rubin told Israel Radio.
Assassin Yigal Amir, who recently turned 27, is serving a life sentence for shooting Rabin in the back on November 4, 1995, to halt his peacemaking with Arab partners.
The murder enraged Israelis across the political spectrum but some extremists opposed to conciliation with the Arabs have expressed support for Amir.
Left-wing legislator Ran Cohen said he complained to police against the party.
"I have asked police...to stop these scums," he told the radio.
